definitions.short: Naphtali , a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory
definitions.full: H5321. Naphtali נַפְתָּלִי proper name, masculine and of a tribe Naphtali , Νεφθαλει ( μ ), etc. (interpreted as my wrestling Gen 30:8 ; perhaps originally crafty, cunning one ); — 1 second son of Jacob and Bilhah Gen 30:8 (J), 35:25 ; 46:24 (P), 1Chr 2:2 , compare Gen 49:21 (poem). 2 as a tribe of Israel: a. Judg 1:33 ; 4:10 ; 5:18 ; Deut 33:23 (twice in verse) +; so (Hexateuch, only P) נ ׳בְּנֵי Judg 4:6 ; Num 1:42 6 t., נ ׳מַטֵּה 2:29 ; 1Kin 7:14 5 t., נ בְּנֵי ׳מַטֵּה Num 10:27 ; 34:28 ; Josh 19:39 ; נ ׳שַׁעַר Ezek 48:34 (in new Jerusalem); נ ׳אֶרֶץ 1Kin 15:20 ; 2Kin 15:29 , compare Isaiah 8:23; נ ׳קֶדֶשׁ Judg 4:6 ; נ ׳הַר Josh 20:7 ; נ ׳גְּבוּל Ezek 48:4 , נ ׳יָ֫מָּה 48:3 ; נ ׳עָרֵי 2Chr 16:4 . b. as territorial name Deut 34:2 (JE) 1Kin 4:15 ; 1 Chronicles 12:41 (van d. H. v. 1Chr 12:40 ), 2Chr 34:6 ; Judg 6:35 ; 7:23 might be a or b.
